ryan_sales: FYI - EmeraldCare sent a CAIQ-like packet + SIG spreadsheet, ~365 Qs. They need a completed intake by Wed 09:00 PT for procurement review. Uploaded doc: https://drive.redwood/emerald/EC_CAIO_SIG_0426.xlsx @lia_security @sam_se

sec-bot: Intake ticket EC-2026-901 created. Priority: urgent. Owner: unassigned. SLA: 72h.

sam_se: jumping in. Do we know if EmeraldCare requires customer-managed KMS or will they accept BYOK via cloud KMS? Also are they mandating quarterly pen-test evidence in raw form?

ryan_sales: Contact is Priya Menon (Procurement). priya.m@emeraldcare.io. They said BYOK acceptable but flagged key escrow + dual control as "must clarify" items. Pen-test raw artifacts are requested into their vendor portal; they said redacted is fine if we have NDA.

lia_security: I'll take intake. Plan: split doc into SIG domains, map to our evidence catalog, flag any Req > designs as blockers. ETA: initial mapping in 24h, draft answers in 48h. Assigning EC-2026-901 to lia_security.

sec-bot: EC-2026-901 updated: owner=lia_security; due=2026-04-27T16:00:00Z.

lia_security: Quick summary after first pass: 365 Qs -> 64 control clusters. Blockers/high attention (4):
- Key escrow / third-party key access asks (they want proof of no escrow for hosted).
- HSM-backed keystore requirement for PHI in Private deployments.
- Evidence of least privilege on service principals for model ops (IAM policies).
- Proof of pen-test remediation for any critical/high findings in last 12 months.

sam_se: For options: Hosted + contractual commitments + SOC2 + redacted pentest might satisfy them if they accept provider-managed KMS. If they demand HSM CMKs, we need Dedicated + HSM or Private. I'll prepare two quotes: hosted-compliant + private-HSM.

anna_legal: We can provide SOC2 Type II and redacted pentest under our standard NDA. If they want raw pen-test logs, we'll need a scoped SOW/NDA and risk review. Ryan - confirm whether Emerald already signed our standard DPA.

ryan_sales: They returned a signed DPA last week. Priya asked for the vendor security packet asap to avoid delaying contract.

lia_security: Draft response snippets ready for the portal (short form):
1) Encryption at rest: AES-256; hosted uses cloud KMS (no customer key escrow); Private supports HSM-backed CMKs with dual-control on request.
2) Transit: TLS1.3 enforced on all customer traffic.
3) KMS ownership: Customer-managed keys available on Private; Hosted supports BYOK in certain regions; escrow not performed by Redwood.
4) Pen-test artifacts: Redacted reports available after NDA; raw artifacts require escrowed transfer and legal sign-off.
5) Access control: Role-based access + service principal policies; we maintain separation of duties and require MFA for admin consoles.
6) Logging: Audit logs sent to customer-managed destination for Dedicated/Private; hosted has export options.

sam_se: I'll attach a PHI addendum and cost delta: Dedicated + per-tenant HSM ~ +$48k/mo, 6-8 week setup. Hosted with contractual protections ~ lower up-front but not HSM CMK.

anna_legal: I'll prep the NDA template for redacted pentest exchange. Lia, please mark which artifacts we must redact (IP details, exploit PoC).

lia_security: Noted. I'll produce an evidence checklist listing the required artifacts and which ones need redaction. Target: send Emerald a prioritized top-12 walk-through and evidence bundle by Tue 17:00 PT.

ryan_sales: Great - I'll tell Priya we aim to deliver prioritized answers + estimate by Tue 17:00 and full SIG by Wed 09:00 PT. Priya is pushing procurement review, so speed matters.

sec-bot: EC-2026-901 comment added: owner lia_security; next_update=2026-04-26T00:00:00Z.

sam_se: If Lia hits any gating legal items, tag @anna_legal. I'll assemble the two pricing scenarios and a short PHI compliance FAQ for Sales to use in contract review.

ryan_sales: thanks team. looping Priya on NDA + timeline. I'll post here once she acknowledges.
